_readme: Cover files whose IATA code cannot be a filename on Windows. `AUX` is a
legacy DOS device name, so `public/maps/AUX.png` resolves to the device
`\\.\AUX` instead of a file: git cannot index it (add fails with
`open(...): No such file or directory` even though the entry is visible), so
the file can never be committed and the deploy box would never receive it.
The escaped name below is what actually lives on disk; every reader maps
code -> file name through this table:
Every reader tolerates this file being absent (they then assume
<IATA>.png), but with AUX in the database its absence means the AUX page
silently loses its cover. CON / PRN / NUL are reserved the same way and
would need entries if they ever enter the airport set.
